content: Ye Pol, Qenu wo Munon inubersiau tari eng Yisas wonou misiguor eng ye bo imusi eb qamb yemaribigorei. End an Qenu wonou munon yurau Epesus igoumon end namanimun e gumotoroum. Munon inubersiau tari Yisas wot igub ne toat igoumon.
End Qenu ininou Tain eng nob Yisas Munon inubersiau tari ininou munon baraitari nob wurinou uyes anubersiari oau mein igoarar.
1:3-14 Qenu Munon inubersiau im gab ininou igomurur nonogursi igo
In gugum Qenu, ininou munon barai Yisas wonou ur eng, wot uberet igorun. Munon inubersiau tari wo gab-gab Qenu ininou misir nonogursi wonou ginamt mi uber-uber inimbiga qoyamet igoun.
Qenu wo mi gugum me barsiau qen end Munon inubersiau tari wo gab-gab in wonou yurau igoarar qamb inmaribigorei. Inmaribigine Qenu magqurt in munon qau igo qomon boru gitab igoarar qamb.
Yisas ag e darab inqubeieminer end Qenu qoan inqenungar inmaribig ne in wonou wau init qamar end wo darab inqubeiamorei. Eng Qenu wonou misir end uyes ebeterei.
Qenu sig-sig mom inqenungar ne wonou wau oau uri eng ar init imuriamor end wagari in gugum wo unum bemeni igorun.
Munon inubersiau tari wo sig-sig mom inqenungar ne umb qeru init igeramor end ininou qomon boru birueter end ne see in uber igoun. Ebet ne qoyam uber misir uber inimbigorei.
Qoan Qenu Yisas imurimb misir igor eng wonou qi igoai. End see wonou misir qi igoar eng Yisas ag e darab Qenu wonou misir qi igoar eng aba dibentar eng.

Qenu wo misir igoar eng ete: Mi gugum Qenu wonou ginamt ne ag e barsier eng mom musub qoat igama is-is yarab wonou qen maribigor eng gab mi gugum eng Yisas wot waga wo wurinou gigit igo oroar igoriba.
Wonou qenungau eng igoar end in qoan ir inmaribigorei. Qenu wonou inmaribig ne Yisast in ba qiumuniamorei. Qenu wo mi ebeib qamb qanambig qamar eng ebet qas wager eng.
End in munon yurau qamar Yisast oabig taut igoun. End Qenu wonomi wes ebeter end unum bemeni igorun.

An gor qob apand eng igari Qenu wonou an yonou munon yurau qamb anmaribigorei. Qob uber eng an ba qiumuniamorei. An Yisast oabigari gab Qenu anuruar igo Igomurur Qau qoan init imurimb qamar eng imuriamor eng anboopurima ten igoumon.

Igomurur eng Qenu wonou munon yurau wurit imurimine ete imbigar qamb: Igomurur set inopurima ten igoun eng igoi qen geret mi gugum init iyeter eng irimanima guboun. Qen end Qenu wonou yurau mi ger wuriqororub me ebeinerei, sarog uber igorubour. End in wonomi qiribi ten ebeter end mismisir igorun.
1:15-23 Pol Epesus wurit igub Qenu qebi qamb igoai
Qanam end ye igoum eng an mom Yisas ininou Munon Aib end mom oabig ne Qenu wonou munon yurau eng mom wuriqenungar igoumon.
End ye anit igub Qenut taurab me qamb igoum, qenen annonogursi igoar qamb qebi qamb igoum.

Yisas munon inubersiau tari wonou Ur eng Qenu, wonou ginamt qiribiten igo eng qebi nob qemerine Igomurur imurima anit isub oau anmenima misir uber igub wonou qob qanam eng imbig ne Qenu wonou git gor imbigar qamb.

Ye qebimine aninou misir eng aba wonou begen eng gab imbigar qamb. Ende aba an wonomi mom tenen igub igoarar qamb, anit iyeter eng igub qoat igoarar qamb. End an imbigar, in Qenut igub igumune wonomi init maribigor eng sig uber ar.
An eng imbigar, in Qenut oabigun eng wo mom tenen ete igo innonogursi igo. Gagam eng qiribiten mom innonogursi igo, in maigas me imbigunei.
Wonou gagam qiribiten end gari qoan ebeter eng, Yisas menima der bugamor eng. Bogoma mot irab wonou ginamt end uberegent wes end bugamsier end see wonou unum diban igo.

End ne see Munon inubersiau tari wo munon baraitari Qenu ginamt igour eng, ne munon aib gigit igo eng ne munon qer gagam aib eng ne munon aib-aib eng ne munon unum nob see igour eng, a qen geret igorunor eng gugum wuritanami wo wurinou gigit igo. Ne qen geret eng gor wonou mom ende igoriba.
Qenu sios mi eng gugum mom Yisas goten qanamt end bigorei igama wo wonou tari mom igo qoat igo.
Sios eng Munon inubersiau tari eng wonou git goan igeragart eng. Mi gugum Yisas wo igo, ne sios erobon eng wo yab di iua igo.
